people.name: Hall_of_Judgment
people.line: A hall in Solomon's palace where he administered justice.

people.name: Hall_of_the_Throne
people.line: Another name for the Hall of Judgment in Solomon's palace.

translations.web: He made the porch of the throne where he was to judge, even the porch of judgment; and it was covered with cedar from floor to floor.
translations.bsb: In addition, he built a hall for the throne, the Hall of Justice, where he was to judge. It was paneled with cedar from floor to ceiling.
translations.kjv: Then he made a porch for the throne where he might judge, even the porch of judgment: and it was covered with cedar from one side of the floor to the other.
translations.asv: And he made the porch of the throne where he was to judge, even the porch of judgment: and it was covered with cedar from floor to floor.
